result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 3 (Divisions 36-37: nude entertainment permits and police-regulated burglary and panic alarm systems), published on gocodebook.com under a page URL that points to the algorithmic rent-price-fixing division but whose text does not contain it.
result.notes: This part contains no rules in the six in-scope rental categories. It covers San Diego Municipal Code sections 33.3606 to 33.3708 (nude entertainment business and adult entertainer permits, operating requirements and exemptions; alarm business, alarm agent and alarm system permit rules). The page URL refers to Division 11 'Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price Fixing' (section 98.1103, use and sale of algorithmic devices), but that text does not appear in this part, and no bill-page exception applies because it is not a legislative bill page. No rule is extracted.
